text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a clear, sunny day.
With my morning work finished, I was thinking about going for a walk, when—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello there! Thanks for your hard work.
Are you perhaps heading out somewhere now?
choice_data_list: The weather's nice, so just wandering around
The weather's nice, so just wandering around

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I totally get it.
Days like this make you really want to go out, don't they?
Ah, now I feel like going out somewhere too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! We meet at last, prepare to die!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Howaah!? Who goes there!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Taiki-san?
Why do you have such a sad look on your face...!
What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Your plans to go hang out at the mountain stream with a friend fell through... That really is sad.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It was for my friend's important official inspection, so it could not be helped, yes...
choice_data_list: I doubt it was an official inspection, but that's unfortunate
I doubt it was an official inspection, but that's unfortunate

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted someone to listen to my sad feelings.
So because you two stayed with me, I am very, very happy!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A thank-you huuug!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyawah!! P-P-Please hold on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry!
Tannhauser, do you dislike hugs?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No no! That's not it!
Um, how do I put it... right, I don't hate hugs, um, uhh, ergh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rather than disliking hugs, she seemed merely startled, and frankly, embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To calm down Machikane Tannhauser, who was flustered at being misunderstood, I decided to change the subject for now.
choice_data_list: Since you're going to the mountain stream—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that the two of them go together.
Machikane Tannhauser seemed in the mood for an outing anyway, so it sounded like a fun plan—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
! Yeaaah! That is a very wonderful idea!
Tannhauser, let us go!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes! If you're fine with me, I'd love to!!
I'll follow you wherever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Thank you!!
I am looking forward to it very much, yes!
Let us enjoy together!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, Taiki-san is so kind...!
Even though my reaction might have hurt her feelings...)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(I was just embarrassed.
Taiki-san is so straightforward with her affection that it kinda makes me nervous, or something...)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Ugwaah~! I'm so sorry~! And Trainer-san, thank you for backing up my clumsy self...!)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: (I'll definitely pay you back for this someday~!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer-san, let's go together too!
The more people we have, the more fun it will be!
choice_data_list: Let me know when and I'll clear my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thank you!
My lonely feelings have flown far away!
Fufu. Thank you too, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! Next time, I'll catch you for sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even noticing their conversation wasn't
matching up, Machikane Tannhauser pumped herself
up with a determined "Mun!".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I want to have a barbecue
with everyone! The meat and veggies
will definitely taste more delicious than usual!
choice_data_list: Why don't you invite some other people too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's right!
Maybe someone else can come along too...!
I'm going to go invite them right away!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle dashed off in the blink of an eye.
As I watched her run off—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Kuuu... Taiki-san!!
Actually, earlier, I was just shy... huh!?
Taiki-san!? Taiki-saaan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser wandered around flustered,
looking for Taiki Shuttle who had already disappeared.
